location: after trainable TSST3, before native head; first8 native forecast slots
tokens: 16 historical frames x16 spatial tokens; camera removed; learned 2048->256 projection
locality: 4 nearest 4x4 memory locations per query over all16 observed frames
history_cap: max of last7 observed adjacent RGB differences; 8x8 average pool then3x3 dilation; clamp((change-.01)/.04,0,1)
horizon: learned h1..h8 embedding in Q/gate; sigmoid gate capped by history_cap/sqrt(h)
caveat: restriction applies to geometry delta only, not updates caused by trainable backbone/head; RGB change is not object motion truth
shuffle_control: fixed seed123 content-only spatial permutation held across time during train+val
